newsitem.title: USA: MIDCOM Communications names Zrno chairman.
newsitem.headline: MIDCOM Communications names Zrno chairman.

text.p: MIDCOM Communications Inc said Wednesday it has named John Zrno as its new chairman of the board of directors, effective Dec. 2, replacing Paul Pfleger, who will serve as vice chairman.

"In recent months, (Zrno) has taken an active role in seeking strategic alliances, as well as consulting on day-to-day problems and negotiations," William Oberlin, chief executive officer, said in a statement. Zrno most recently was vice chairman of Frontier Corp, chief executive of ALC Communications Corp, and group president of Cable and Wireless Plc's Cable & Wireless North America.
At all three companies, Oberlin and MIDCOM board member Marvin Moses, were members of Zrno's executive team.
Zrno also served as MCI Communications Corp's first treasurer. He has over 20 years experience in the telecommunications industry.
